title: Clear read-only attributes on validated cache artifacts before removal
requirements: After validating the complete ignored-file inventory and before deleting any cache, clear read-only attributes only inside each already approved .pytest_cache, __pycache__, .pyc or .pyo path.
Preserve all PIPE-011 and PIPE-012 fail-closed boundary, link, unknown-artifact, primary-checkout and Git metadata checks.
Add a Windows-representative regression test with a read-only ignored cache directory and file, and document the ordering guarantee.
acceptance: Cleanup removes validated read-only cache artifacts and then removes the DONE worktree without force.
Unknown ignored artifacts still block cleanup before any approved cache or attribute is changed.
Focused pipeline tests, whitespace validation, self-review, finish and cleanup pass; the previously retained PIPE-012 and PIPE-011 worktrees can then be cleaned with the fixed controller.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Narrow recovery for the real OneDrive read-only cache failure observed while cleaning PIPE-012.
